# BBJake

> BBJake (Jacob Coburn) is a Visalia, California live streamer, YouTuber and event host, known as the 559's #1 content creator. He is CEO of BeenBlessed, a self-owned Christian clothing brand.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.bbjake.com/): live stream, latest videos, merch, partnerships and links
- [About BBJake](https://www.bbjake.com/about): who he is, events, collaborations, community work and how to partner
- [Media Kit](https://www.bbjake.com/media-kit): audience numbers, past events, collaborations and ways to partner
- [Press](https://www.bbjake.com/press): news coverage and media requests
- [Community](https://www.bbjake.com/community): giveback events and the BeenBlessed nonprofit goal
